s: Ubo seip echad: ap mi sheeno nizhar bekol hashshana mippat shel palter goy (ayyen beyoreh dea siman qy"b), mikkol maqom baaseret yeme teshuba yesh lo lizzaher mimmennu. Veim eno yakol leepot beatzmo — yakshir et hattannur sheopin bo goyim, sheyyashlik yisrael betok hattannur qesam echad kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qy"b. Mikkol maqom, mi sheholek badderek im en lepanayv pat shel yisrael ad yoter mearba milin mimmaqom shehu omed bo verotzeh leekol — muttar lo leekol pat shel palter goy apillu baaseret yeme teshuba kemo shemmuttar bishar yemot hashshana kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea sham. Veyesh lekol adam lechappes ulemashmesh bemaasayv velashub mehem baaseret yeme teshuba, usepeq abera tzerika yoter teshuba meabera vaddait, ki al abera vaddait adam mitcharet bekol libbo, abal sepeq abera hu mitbarek bilbabo lomar shemma lo asiti abera veeno mitcharet aleha charata gemura vahare nishar onesh haabera alayv, ulekak haya tzarik qorban asham taluy habba al hassapeq lihyot yoter beyoqer miqqorban chattat habba al havvadday:
